claims.evidence: Photo 2 shows faint text and a logo but no legible capacity marking.
Photos cannot show country of origin or prior-use history.
Photo 2 shows a hole in the base ring of the large orange cylinder.
Photo 2 shows a hole in the base ring, indicating damage.

risks.risk: Cylinder may be empty or partially filled; contents unknown
risks.proof: Video or photo of the cylinder on a weighing scale showing net weight, or a valve discharge test.

risks.risk: Valve and regulator may not function
risks.proof: Clip of the valve being opened and closed and the regulator attached and tested.

risks.risk: Gas leaks at valve or regulator
risks.proof: Leak-test clip with soapy water on all connections showing no bubbles.
Borescope video or open-valve shot showing a clean interior.
Legible close-up of stamped date code on cylinder body.

risks.risk: Last safety inspection or test date unknown
risks.proof: Photo of inspection/test stamp or certificate.

risks.risk: Hole in base ring compromises structural integrity
risks.proof: Close-up video of the hole and surrounding metal, plus a pressure-holding test.

proof_requests: Legible photo of capacity/weight marking on cylinder body
Video of valve operation and regulator test
Photo of last safety inspection/test stamp
response.reason: The witness identifies the items as gas cylinders, so a worst-case price is possible despite unproven claims and hidden risks.
